analogy.rationale: Sigma receptor agonists act mainly on SIGMAR1, which is widely expressed but has limited transcriptional impact in these cell lines, and on NMDA-type glutamate receptors that are poorly expressed in most of these lines, so the response should be weak. The closest reference classes are sigma receptor antagonists (same target), glutamate receptor antagonists/modulators (shared GRIN targets), and a few neuromodulatory receptor classes that cross-react with sigma sites.
